interpretation: Conditional entropy H(param_type | command) in bits, computed over explicit G0/G1/G2/G3 lines in train_sequences.npz (fold_1, full_window). For each command, we count the axis letters (X/Y/Z/F/S/I/J/K/R) that appear on the same physical line as the command token, then compute Shannon entropy of that empirical distribution. The weighted average uses per-command parameter counts as weights. Low H(param|cmd) means the parameter axis is highly predictable once the command is known (e.g., G0/G1 are dominated by X/Y/Z; G2/G3 add I/J/K offsets). This entropy is an upper bound on what a per-command axis-prior baseline could exploit without conditioning on numerical state.

support.definition: H(param_type | command=c) = -sum_a p(a|c) log2 p(a|c); weighted_avg = sum_c P(c) * H(param_type | command=c)
